subject: Security portal evidence automation proposal / BlueCrest
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Julie Halvorsen <julie.h@bluecrest.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security portal evidence automation proposal / BlueCrest

Hi Julie —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. As discussed, we put together a short proposal for automating evidence syncs from Redwood into your OneTrust vendor profile to reduce manual uploads in future revalidation cycles. Attached are: (1) a one-page automation flow and (2) a CSV mapping of Redwood evidence fields to the SIG/CAIQ question IDs we can populate.

High-level ask: confirm whether BlueCrest can accept programmatic uploads via the OneTrust API (preferred) or whether the S3-drop + manual ingest is the only supported path for partner profiles.

Proposal outline:
- Pilot scope (4 weeks): automate 60% of regularly rotated evidence (S3 credential lists, SOC2 certs, KMS rotation notes) into the vendor portal.
- Mapping: we’ve pre-mapped the most common SIG/CAIQ rows; see evidence-field-mapping.csv.
- Auth: we can either push via an API key (recommended) or provide signed S3 objects to a staging bucket.
- Ownership: Redwood will provide signed artifacts; BlueCrest to verify and accept in OneTrust.
- Rollout: weekly syncs during pilot, then bi-weekly after stabilization.

Decisions we need from you:
1) API vs S3 preference (and the contact for provisioning API credentials)
2) Any specific metadata BlueCrest requires (custom fields, retention flags)
3) A target date for pilot start (we’re aiming for week of July 5)

Attachments: redwood-evidence-automation-flow.pdf, evidence-field-mapping.csv

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Strategic Accounts (West)
Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Julie Halvorsen <julie.h@bluecrest.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: security-portal@bluecrest.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security portal evidence automation proposal / BlueCrest

Hi Rishi —

Appreciate the write-up and attachments. This looks promising and would definitely reduce the back-and-forth during our revalidations. A couple quick clarifications before we route to our integrator team: 

- BlueCrest’s current vendor portal (OneTrust) supports a REST ingest API for profile-level documents and metadata; however, we require a scoped API token and an allowlist for the source IPs. S3-drop is still supported but triggers a manual intake step on our side (slower).
- Please capture two metadata fields we need on each upload: "document_type" (SOC2, Policy, Diagram, etc.) and "rotation_cycle" (quarterly, annual).

We can provision a scoped API token for the pilot. Security will need to confirm the allowlist windows for your CI IP ranges. I’ll loop our integrator (security-portal@bluecrest.com) to coordinate.

For timeline: provisioning usually takes 7-10 business days from request; the week of July 5 looks feasible if we start token provisioning next week.

Best,
Julie
Director, Vendor Risk Management
BlueCrest Analytics
julie.h@bluecrest.com

Thanks Rishi — nice clear proposal. Couple internal items I’m capturing after Julie’s note: 

Action items (internal):
- Olga: please validate the evidence ids in evidence-field-mapping.csv against our S3 bucket naming schema and add the "document_type" and "rotation_cycle" columns (due Mon 6/14).
- Olga & Infra: prepare a temporary allowlist of our egress IPs and confirm they’re static for the pilot window (Olga, please coordinate with infra and paste CIDRs in the doc by Tue 6/15).
- Rishi: I’ll draft the token provisioning request to BlueCrest early next week and attach the minimal access scope (upload-only + metadata).
- Lauren: schedule a 30-minute kickoff with Julie and security-portal@bluecrest.com for Wed 6/23 to align on acceptance criteria and sample file layout. Invite sent to tentative calendar.

Notes: we should keep the pilot scope limited to non-sensitive artifacts (SOC2 PDF, encryption KMS rotation notes, rotation logs) — avoid any log-level data or customer PII. Also recommend enabling checksum verification in the pipeline so BlueCrest can validate integrity on ingest.

Link: https://docs.redwood.com/security/automation-proposal (internal planning doc with sample payloads).

—
Lauren Bishop

Redwood Inference
